title: Untitled integer in Mermaid Config Schema | Mermaid
snippet: Defines the maximum number of edges that can be drawn in a graph. Default 500. This is a secure configuration that cannot be set via configuration inside the diagram; call mermaid.initialize to modify this limit.
claim: A mermaid flowchart with more than 500 edges is refused by default (Error: Edge limit exceeded)

snippet: When a diagram's source text exceeds 50,000 characters, Mermaid silently replaces the entire diagram with a "Maximum text size in diagram exceeded" message, which occurs even when the diagram is otherwise valid.
claim: A mermaid diagram whose source exceeds 50000 characters renders as an error message
